title: Universal Image-to-Working-3D-Model & Simulation Skill
short_summary: Transforms any reference image—a vehicle, architectural structure, mechanical weapon or prop, organic human or creature, or full multi-biome environment—into a working, articulated, physically grounded AAA Three.js 3D model and interactive 60fps simulation. Enforces optical camera probing, C2 Laplacian and Catmull-Rom lofted geometry with position-hashed normal welding, hardware-GPU safe PMREM and NaN guards, 100% vertex-to-physics height parity, 1-writer-per-file swarm isolation, 400% macro-crop harsh domain critics, and CSPRNG double-blind side-by-side A/B jury verification. Use whenever turning an image into a working 3D model or playable Three.js scene. Don't use for static 2D HTML/CSS landing pages (use image-to-react or jason-dev-agent).
